parts.label: (b)
parts.part_stem:
The radius of a small sphere is determined from a measurement of the volume of the sphere. The sphere is submerged in water, displacing some of the water into a measuring cylinder as shown in Fig. 1.1.
{{figure:figure_1_1}}
Fig. 1.1 (not to scale)
The measured volume of displaced water is $(28.0 \pm 0.5 \text{ cm}^3)$.

parts.text: the radius, in cm, of the sphere

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: the percentage uncertainty in the radius of the sphere.
